title: My registrations
description: View your event and trip registrations, check their status, and confirm or cancel when asked.
confirmPrompt: Your place is ready. Confirm your participation to keep it, or cancel if you cannot attend.
confirmationUnavailable: Confirmation will be available when the registration service is connected.
cancellationUnavailable: Cancellation will be available when the registration service is connected.

attendance.qrDescription: Show this code at the event entrance. This is the same QR code provided in your confirmation email.
attendance.qrPending: Your QR code will appear here after the ticket service is connected.

actionDialog.confirmMessage: By confirming, you commit to attending this event. If you confirm and do not attend, it may affect whether your future event registrations are accepted.
actionDialog.cancelMessage: Are you sure you want to cancel your place for this event?

unavailableDescription: Your event and trip registrations will appear here after the registration service is connected.
emptyDescription: When you register for an event or trip, you can follow its status here.
